steps.do: Ask for 2 of: DOB, email, phone, address. Look up the customer with get_user_information_by_name, by_email or by_id, and compare the values.
steps.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log and the rolling-window check
steps.if: 2 of the 4 values match the records
steps.quote: A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

steps.do: Get the customer's referral history with timestamps
steps.quote: This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.

steps.do: Count referrals of any account type whose timestamp falls within 9 days before the current time. If 2 or more, a new referral would be auto-denied. Tell the customer this, and that they must wait until the oldest one is more than 9 days old. Give no account recommendation or bonus details, and stop.
steps.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.

steps.if: the rolling window is not full
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get the customer's accounts. Find the earliest date_opened among checking accounts and compute tenure in days up to the current time.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full
steps.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

steps.do: Ask for the referred person's address (same as the customer's?), age, planned qualifying deposit, and any Rho-Bank accounts held or closed in the past 12 months
steps.if: the rolling window is not full
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: Tell the customer the referral would be denied if any of these hold: same registered address, referred person not a new customer, or tenure below every program's minimum. Do not recommend an account.
steps.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

steps.do: Find every personal checking account where all of these hold: the referrer's tenure meets the account's tenure minimum; the planned deposit meets its qualifying deposit; the referred person's age fits; this year's referrals of that type are below the annual cap. Among them, recommend the one with the highest referrer + referred bonus and state both amounts.
steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

steps.do: The customer submits the referral for the recommended account type, written with 'Account' at the end (e.g. 'Blue Account')

args.account_type: the recommended account type, e.g. 'Blue Account'

steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, across all checking account types. A third referral in the window is automatically denied.
rules.quote: You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

rules.rule: After a rolling-window denial, the customer must wait until the oldest referral in the window is more than 9 days old
rules.quote: If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.

rules.rule: Referrer and referred person must not be registered at the same address
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The referred person must be 18 or older, except for Light Green (minors allowed with a guardian)
rules.quote: The referred person must be 18 years or older, except for the Light Green Account which allows minors with a guardian.

rules.rule: Tenure is measured from the earliest checking account's open date, whatever account types the customer holds
rules.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

rules.rule: The qualifying deposit must be new money, not a transfer from another Rho-Bank account
rules.quote: The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.

rules.rule: Blue: $35 referrer + $30 referred = $65 combined; deposit $500 within 60 days; tenure 30 days; 5 per calendar year
rules.quote: Yes. When you refer someone to open a Blue Account, you earn $35 for each successful referral. The person you refer receives $30 as a welcome bonus.

rules.rule: Blue: deposit $500 within 60 days; tenure 30 days from the first checking account
rules.quote: The referred person must deposit at least $500 within 60 days of opening their account. A minimum banking relationship of 30 days is required to participate—this is measured from when you first opened any checking account with us.

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free: $20 + $35 = $55; deposit $300 within 60 days; tenure 30 days; 4 per year
rules.quote: Your Rho-Bank checking relationship must span at least 30 days.

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free bonus amounts: $20 referrer, $35 referred
rules.quote: New member reward: $35 welcome bonus

rules.rule: Green (checking): $20 + $30 = $50; deposit $500 within 60 days; tenure 30 days; 5 per year
rules.quote: Account tenure requirement: 30 days since becoming a Rho-Bank checking customer.

rules.rule: Light Blue: $30 + $20 = $50; deposit $500 within 60 days; tenure 30 days; 5 per calendar year
rules.quote: To qualify as a referrer, you must have been a Rho-Bank checking account holder for 30 days or longer.

rules.rule: Light Green: $15 + $25 = $40; 3 per calendar year
rules.quote: They receive: $25 as a welcome bonus

rules.rule: Light Green: deposit $100 within 90 days; tenure 14 days
rules.quote: Referrer eligibility is based on account tenure: you must have opened your first Rho-Bank checking account at least 14 days ago.

rules.rule: Light Green: the account holder must be aged 13 to 24
rules.quote: You must be the primary account holder and be between 13 and 24 years old to open the account.

rules.rule: Evergreen: $35 + $25 = $60; deposit $750 within 60 days; tenure 45 days
rules.quote: The 45-day tenure threshold applies—calculated from the date you opened your first Rho-Bank checking account.

rules.rule: Dark Green: $40 + $30 = $70; deposit $1,000 within 60 days; tenure 45 days
rules.quote: You must satisfy the 45-day minimum as a Rho-Bank checking customer.

rules.rule: Purple: $45 + $35 = $80; deposit $1,000 within 60 days; tenure 45 days
rules.quote: Participation requires 45 days of checking account history with Rho-Bank.

rules.rule: Gold Years: $50 + $75 = $125; referred person must be 62 or older; deposit $1,000 within 90 days; tenure 30 days
rules.quote: The person you refer must be eligible for a Gold Years Account (age 62+)

rules.rule: Bluest: $75 + $50 = $125; deposit $2,000 within 90 days; tenure 60 days
rules.quote: Qualifying requirement: Referred person must deposit $2,000 within 90 days

rules.rule: A referral bonus cannot be combined with other new-account promotions
rules.quote: The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and the referral history has been checked. Either (a) the customer was told the referral would be denied (rolling window full, same address, not a new customer, or not enough tenure) and given no recommendation, or (b) the customer was told the eligible account with the highest combined bonus, with both bonus amounts and the qualifying deposit, and submitted submit_referral with that account type ending in 'Account'.

open_questions: Does the 9-day cap count every referral in the history or only ones that earn bonuses (e.g. COMPLETE / IN_PROGRESS)? This research assumes REJECTED and ERROR referrals do not count and all others do.
Does a referral exactly 9 days old (to the timestamp) still count inside the window? Compare exact timestamps with get_current_time.
No document gives a rule for ties between accounts with the same combined bonus.
No document says how the agent should verify the referred person's address beyond the customer's statement.
